ops.title: VM scenarios assert a holder socket bind that no longer happens
ops.description:
`scripts/vm/scenarios/verify-signed-topology.sh` and `verify-tcc-upgrade-reboot.sh` both set

    HOLDER_SOCKET="$VM_GUEST_HOME/.cc-pool/fusekit/fusekit.sock"

and then `die` unless the signed app binds **both** `$BROKER_SOCKET` and `$HOLDER_SOCKET` (verify-signed-topology.sh:84,90; verify-tcc-upgrade-reboot.sh:75).

Nothing has bound that holder path since fusekit `b313adf` (2026-08-03) — `RuntimePaths.Socket` has no binder anywhere in fusekit; the holder actually serves on daemonkit's label socket. So these assertions have been wrong for two weeks and presumably have not been run since (they need a VM).

The broker-socket half is **still correct** and must be kept: `$BROKER_SOCKET` is the App Group endpoint under `Library/Group Containers/<group>/fusekit.sock`, which is live (`socketLeaf: "fusekit.sock"` in `widget/Sources/FileProviderRuntime/Configuration.swift`). Only the holder half is dead — do not delete both.

After the mint/adopt cutover there is no holder socket path at all from the broker's side; the holder's own serving socket is daemonkit's per-agent socket, which after the state-root move is:

    ~/.daemonkit/agents/com.yasyf.cc-pool.status.fusekit/daemon.sock

Fix is probably to point `HOLDER_SOCKET` there, but it needs a VM run to confirm — hence not done inline.

Related cleanup already landed in the same pass: `pool.FuseKitSocketPath()` (dead, no production callers) and its `paths_test.go` assertion deleted, and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:72` corrected — it claimed the app forwards catalog traffic to that endpoint.

ops.text: HOLDER_SOCKET in both VM scenarios points at a path the holder actually binds
BROKER_SOCKET App Group assertion left intact
Both scenarios run green against a VM after the daemonkit + fusekit release
